audience: warehouse and fulfilment teams that run orders and stock in Mintsoft

useCases.title: Track an order
useCases.text: Search for an order and read its comments and shipments.

useCases.title: Check stock levels
useCases.text: Read the stock levels and the inventory records of a product.

useCases.title: Review stock movements
useCases.text: List the stock movements to find where units went.

useCases.title: Check inbound deliveries
useCases.text: List the ASNs and open one to see what the warehouse expects.

useCases.title: Review returns
useCases.text: List the returns and open one to read the details.

useCases.title: Flag an order for the team
useCases.text: Add a comment and a tag to an order that needs attention.
